# Badge

A short label for a status, category or count, next to what it describes.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Dense data</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Dense data:** Alert status in rows.

- **Use it when:** A state people scan for in a list or table, or a small category label.
- **Not when:** A message people must read (alert or toast), or an action (a button).

Instead:

- [Alert](./alert.md): A message, not a label.
- [Button](./button.md): Something to press.

## How Dense data uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A status</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Badge with a subtle fill, an icon and a word</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A full-strength fill</div></div><div class="cap">Subtle fills let many statuses share one table.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">Shape of a status badge</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> radius.badge (rectangle)</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A pill</div></div><div class="cap">Rectangles line up in a column.</div></div></div>

## Why it works this way

Badge looks the way it does because of 2 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Badge, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-accessibility-count"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How many signals carry each meaning?</b><code>accessibility.count</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Three: color, icon and word</div><p>Many statuses share one table; color alone is not enough.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Badge</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>neutral</b>: New and False positive: not triaged yet, or a finished outcome that is not a failure.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>info</b>: Investigating: an analyst is on it; news, nothing to act on.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>success</b>: Resolved: contained and closed.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>warning</b>: Escalated: needs a senior analyst soon, still containable.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>danger</b>: Breach confirmed: a real loss.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Alert: destructive</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">5</div><small>Badge decisions would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-content-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the main content?</b><code>content.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Numbers and records</div><p>Most of the screen is numbers and records.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Badge</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>neutral</b>: New and False positive: not triaged yet, or a finished outcome that is not a failure.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>info</b>: Investigating: an analyst is on it; news, nothing to act on.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>success</b>: Resolved: contained and closed.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>warning</b>: Escalated: needs a senior analyst soon, still containable.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>danger</b>: Breach confirmed: a real loss.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Sidebar: default</code> <code>Sidebar: outline</code> <code>Empty: default</code> <code>Item: default</code> <code>Item: outline</code> <code>Toggle: default</code> <code>Toggle: outline</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">5</div><small>Badge decisions would reopen</small><p>and 44 answers that follow from it: <b>A lot</b>, <b>Scan and compare</b>, <b>People keep their place</b>, and 41 more.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Lead with the object, then the state: "Alert 2041 contained."
- Use numbers, not words for numbers.
- One verb per button. No "please", no exclamation marks.
- Use: Investigate, Filter, Assign, Escalated, Resolved. Avoid: Oops, Awesome, Please, Simply.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Retry
- `content.action.empty-action`: Change filters

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The status is a word; color and icon add to it, never replace it. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add badge
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
